_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
homeland: no fixed homeland (tunnel-warrens and trap-riddled dens)

branch.regression: yips + high clicks (q -> k' click, k -> tk', sh -> ts', drop/clip finals, vowels raise i/e, diminutive -ik/-ek)
branch.nature: small reptile-dog vermin; the most degraded and simple; trap-makers and tunnelers
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into a kobold's yipping throat

_note: Beastman culture: KOBOLDS, small reptile-dog vermin - the most degraded beastman tongue, shrill yips and high clicks (qatal 'kill' -> k'atik). Cowardly, numerous, trap-cunning. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Little Gnasher / the Trap-Lizard). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed (no gendered ending); totems descriptive Kazhur. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Kobold (Kazhur, yip-click regression): q -> k' (click), k -> tk', sh -> ts', finals dropped/clipped, vowels raise to i/e, diminutive -ik/-ek; shrill, quick, high.
phonology.phonotactics: short CV(C) with clicks and glottal stops; high pitch; clipped.

morphology.naming_marker: named by the k'ats'ep at a blooding; a quick yip-name.
morphology.plural: k'-doubling or -ik-im; mostly a swarming uncounted many

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / tunnel-warren (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic. Race-totem the Little Gnasher / the Trap-Lizard. The k'ats'ep yips to the totem and the Gul-spirits over trap-pits and bone-piles; the One and the sun are demonized (kobolds shun the light).

venerated.Noctiluna (the hiding dark): Gul-Naktilu (the dark that hides the warren)

demonized.Tulrius (the sun): Tarul the Burning-Eye (the light that finds them)

religion.shaman_rites: yip-chants over trap-pits, bone-piles, and stolen-hoards; the totem's little skull on a stick.

holy_symbol_motifs.Little Gnasher: a tiny gnashing jaw over a snare
holy_symbol_motifs.Gul-Lusanu: a heap of stolen teeth and coins

banks_patterns.war_bands: the yip-named swarms: 'the Sharp-teeth', 'the Trap-setters', 'the Tunnel-rats of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: trap-riddled tunnel-warrens and bone-piles: 'the Warren of [tribe]', 'the Trap-tunnels of [chief]', 'the Bone-pile of [name]'
